notes.title: Thalassic Dice Dev Update #1
notes.content: [p]Ahoy! [/p][p][/p][p]It's been a busy few weeks since announcing Thalassic Dice and I'd like to thank everyone for the kind words and excitement for the game! [/p][p][/p][p]I've been hard at work focusing on implementing feedback that I got after launching the steam page, so here's some highlights from that! [/p][h3][/h3][h3]Dev Log[/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644942/3d8e7e319ba5226c092a7baf75a42fd92d0bac42.gif"][/img][/h3][p]I've focused a lot on visual effects, improving how the game looks and adding some much needed movement![/p][list][*][p]Screen Shake + damage particles when the ship takes damage[/p][/*][*][p]Weather Effects (snow, rain, heat distortion, etc. )[/p][/*][*][p]Added some movement to the Sails of the Ship[/p][/*][/list][p]I've updated the die model and textures to better fit the visual theme. [/p][p]Also working on some other things I'm not quite ready to talk about yet! But keep an eye out here for more updates! [/p][p][/p][p]All of the changes can be seen in the [b]updated gameplay trailer[/b]:[/p][previewyoutube="4ljBRvdgMeI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][p]Bonus: I got some good music inspiration by going to a really good jazz concert featuring Mischa Blanos & Anthony Gutierrez and Chico Freeman - Reto Weber Duo which I highly recommend. (no, there unfortunately won't be any actual jazz in Thalassic Dice)[/p][p][/p][p]Calm Seas,[/p][p]TidalDog[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
